mechanism_narrative: A lower current level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns is >= -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in the lowest quartile of FEDFUNDS are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.3 percentage points over the past three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months, the 20-day forward returns are positive, or the Rank IC between the 3-month change in UNRATE and 20-day returns is >= -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5) and a non-decreasing federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS change <= 0 over 3 months) signals persistent inflationary pressures without accommodative monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 3.5 and FEDFUNDS change <= 0 over 3 months
failure_condition: In more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.5 and FEDFUNDS change <= 0 over 3 months, the 20-day forward returns are positive, or the interaction effect (as measured by a regression with interaction term) is not significant (p>0.05) over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (characterized by high housing starts), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals an impending slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST declines by more than 0.5% over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC between the 3-month change in HOUST and 20-day returns in late-cycle expansion is >= -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 0.5 percentage points over the past three months signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between the 3-month change in INDPRO and 60-day returns is < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances where INDPRO rises > 0.5% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 0.5 percentage points over the past three months signals strong consumer and housing demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS rises > 0.5% and HOUST rises > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: In more than 60% of instances where RSAFS and HOUST both rise >0.5% in 3 months, the 20-day forward returns are negative, or the interaction effect (as measured by a regression with interaction term) is not significant (p>0.05) over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A current inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) above 3.5% signals persistent inflationary pressures that may lead to aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between CPIAUCSL and 5-day returns is >= -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.5.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past three months signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between the 3-month change in PAYEMS and 60-day returns is < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances where PAYEMS rises > 0.5% in 3 months.
